name: tutorial-icon-guide
title: Tutorial Icon Guide
description: Coach-mark gestures drawn over the page, never in the way of input. tap: a mouse pointer or pointing finger (picked by the device, or forced) presses a target on repeat with a press ripple. drag: an arrowhead glides along a curved path from one target to another, trailing a fading smear, with optional marching dashes. Targets are refs, elements, points or functions, tracked every frame. Reduced motion holds the tap still and draws a plain arrow.
